clause: Develop read/observe surfaces (histogram, navigation, before/after, filmstrip, cache) [STU-RAW-004]

scope.summary: Implement the develop read/observe projections of StudioRawDevelop state to operator UI and model command surface per [STU-DOC-004] (never a separate model shim): live histogram with shadow/highlight clipping toggles; zoom/pan/hand navigation with zoom presets + full-screen review; before/after cycling + per-panel adjustment-visibility toggling; multi-image filmstrip with sort/filter (capture date, name, rating, color label), per-image star ratings, color labels, mark-for-deletion; and a configurable preview/settings cache with max size, purge, and relocation held outside authority under the typed SurrealDB boundary and PostgreSQL/SQLite tripwire.
acceptance_criteria: read/observe surfaces render + query; filmstrip sort/filter/rating; cache controls; no PostgreSQL/SQLite
proof_targets: Argus inspect of histogram/filmstrip + cache-control test
expected_tests: argus: histogram + clipping toggles + navigation reachable with stable author_ids
test: preview/settings cache purge+relocate; no PostgreSQL/SQLite

target_entries: Studio / Camera Raw & Develop / Reviewing and navigating

risk_if_missed: No inspection/navigation surface; operator+model cannot observe develop state.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
